DEPARTED to ARRIVED; records the arrival of the trip (RecordArrival) and publishes LoadArrived (with departureKind and nodeType), which last-mile-delivery uses to induct the packages at a delivery station, and DepartureArrived. Receiving an ARRIVED load returns it unchanged.
